## Varied series narration and voice checks

Release and blog series now write narration as a coordinated set, with varied openings and closers, connected overview intros, first-person actions, and clearer guidance for breaking changes, accessibility evidence, and cross-version comparisons.

`check_narration_voice.py` adds a `--series` mode that checks sibling scripts together for shared openers, closers, and repeated transition phrases. Single-script checks also flag template lead-ins, repeated contrasts, release-note openers, bare imperatives, and uniform pause tags.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
